description: This Java test class contains integration tests for the loan account payment allocation feature in the Apache Fineract project. It focuses on scenarios involving overlapping disbursements, down payments, and different repayment strategies, validating schedule generation and transaction sequences.

classes.name: LoanAccountPaymentAllocationWithOverlappingDownPaymentInstallmentTest
classes.description: An integration test suite for verifying payment allocation logic under overlapping disbursements and down payments within the Fineract loan module.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes RESTAssured configuration, request/response specifications, and helper instances before each test.

methods.name: loanAccountWithEnableDownPaymentAndEnableAutoRepaymentForDownPaymentWithOverlappingInstallmentPaymentAllocationTest
methods.description: Test scenario where down payment and auto-repayment are enabled; disbursing funds with overlapping installments and validating schedule accuracy.

methods.name: loanAccountWithEnableDownPaymentAndDisableAutoRepaymentForDownPaymentWithOverlappingInstallmentPaymentAllocationTest
methods.description: Test scenario with down payment enabled but auto-repayment disabled; overlapping disbursements and schedule validation.

methods.name: loanAccountWithEnableDownPaymentAndDisableAutoRepaymentForDownPaymentWithOverlappingInstallmentForMultipleDisbursementsOnSameDayTest
methods.description: Test with multiple disbursements on the same day overlapping installment schedules, assessing schedule adjustments.

methods.name: loanAccountWithEnableDownPaymentAndDisableAutoRepaymentForDownPaymentWithOverlappingInstallmentForMultipleDisbursementsOnSameDayTest
methods.description: Test involving multiple disbursements on the same day, overlapping installment due dates, and schedule validation.

methods.name: loanAccountWithEnableDownPaymentWithAdvancedPaymentAllocationWithProgressiveScheduleGenerationMultipleDisbursementsOnSameDayTest
methods.description: Tests down payment with advanced payment allocation and progressive schedule generation, with multiple disbursements on the same day.

methods.name: verifyDisbursementPeriod
methods.description: Validates the disbursement period details against expected date and amount.

methods.name: verifyPeriodDetails
methods.description: Validates detailed period data against expected values for amount, paid amount, outstanding, fees, penalties, and dates.

methods.name: createLoanAccountMultipleRepaymentsDisbursement
methods.description: Creates and approves a loan account with specified disbursement and repayment schedule.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithEnableDownPaymentAndMultipleDisbursements
methods.description: Creates a loan product with down payment enabled and multiple disbursements.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithAdvancedPaymentStrategyAndProgressiveLoanSchedule
methods.description: Creates a loan product configured for advanced payment allocation with a progressive schedule.

methods.name: checkDownPaymentTransaction
methods.description: Verifies that a down payment transaction matching the specified date and amounts exists in the loan's transaction history.
